title: A Resolution of Erdős Problem 550 on Tree versus Complete Multipartite Ramsey Numbers
summary: We resolve Erdős Problem 550, originally asked as question (2) of Erdős, Faudree, Rousseau, and Schelp. Precisely, for fixed integers $k\geq 2$ and $1\leq m_1\leq \cdots \leq m_k$, we prove that, for every sufficiently large $n$ and every $n$-vertex tree $T$, $R(T,K_{m_1,\ldots,m_k}) \leq (k-1)(R(T,K_{m_1,m_2})-1)+m_1$. The proof combines an off-Turán tree-embedding theorem, proved by regularity and whole-edge allocation, with a compactness theorem for bounded-rank hypergraph obstructions. The full and unconditional proof has been formally verified in Lean.
